about_the_game:
A FULLY DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENT

Everything you see can be destroyed: rocks, buildings, dunes, hills and you have many tools to do so. No cover is eternal, paths can be widened, bridges can be broken. Shape the battlefield, surprise your enemies!

20-PLAYERS ARENA BATTLES

Play as a team of 10 players against another team of 10. Kill them all or destroy their pylon, the device encrypting their position and protecting them from orbital strikes. Do defend your own pylon too, or the orbitals won't miss you either. 

TACTICAL PACING

A high TTK (Time to Kill) and inertial movement demand higher tactical and strategic planning. Choose your next destination carefully, get more information, and shoot when you're really ready. Each shot takes time; make them count.

SHIELDS: EASY TO READ, HARD TO KILL

Shields protect you from incoming damage. They are positioned around your Loader, protecting your hull. To destroy enemy Loaders, aim at their uncovered areas. Shields regenerate, hulls never do.

5 VERY DIFFERENT CLASSES

Start customizing your experience by choosing which class you want to play. You have 5 classes to choose from and several more sub-classes offering diverse specialisations. From bruiser to infiltrator, from artillery to healer, from sniper to skirmisher, find the one that suits your playstyle best.

TWEAK AND TUNE YOUR LOADER

You can choose 4 active modules, 4 utility modules, a splitter and up to 5 passive modules. Equip, fight, try, tweak, tune to reach the perfect balance within the 20 units of energy available. Activate them at the right time and place for maximum efficiency.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6800 / NVIDIA Geforce RTX 3080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: War always changes: antigrav tanks and pilots using remote sensing are both called Loaders. Fight 10 vs 10 battles with guns so powerful that rocks are a weak cover and magnetic shields protect your hull. Fight, die, reload: War never ends, but neither do you. Load up again!
